snippet.title: hovercrafts x nihilism trailer
snippet.description:
(https://store.steampowered.com/app/3867360/)

hovercrafts x nihilism is a vehicular shooter colossus-like set in a post apocalyptic world devastated by war and natural disasters. You play as a young revolutionary tasked with recovering an ancient power on a distant planet as your revolution collapses.
